items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Boisau's style, when I was coming up I didn't go for it because everything was Father Hines when I was coming up.

ctx.x: Tell me about somebody like Boisau. Did you hear many piano players like that when you were coming up?

Boisau's style, when I was coming up I didn't go for it because everything was Father Hines when I was coming up. And if you didn't play like Father Hines, the closest thing to Father Hines was a fellow I played with by the name of Dizzy Norman. Later on he was with Bois Maesick. He was not with Bois Maesick, yeah, when I played with Bois Maesick. But Dizzy could play just like Father Hines. But the only thing, he didn't give you a good beat when you were playing. He kind of rambled around the back.
